stage1.ineligibility_reason: Strategic/maturity review and survey of EnMS across 6 companies (pharmaceuticals, medical devices, electronics, semiconductor, dairy) plus the TEMPO energy-tracking tool; EnPIs appear only incidentally (needs/gaps) and no EnPI/EnB measurement model is characterised (no relevant variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach identifiable).

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: a 'Refined Energy Model' (direct 57%/indirect 43%, extended from Seow & Rahimifard 2011) and Energy Intensity Indicators are named but not built as an EnPI/EnB model. Called ineligible; flag for human review. Sparse slide-deck proceedings.
